operators.name: channel_sum
semantics: Computes sum over dimension 1 with keepdim=True, matching torch.sum(x, dim=1, keepdim=True).
Input is contiguous float32 CUDA tensor with shape [N, C, H, W]; output is [N, 1, H, W].
Output layout is contiguous; values are float32 sums across channels for each spatial location.

operators.name: avg_pool2d
semantics: Applies 2D average pooling with specified kernel_size, stride, and padding, exactly matching nn.AvgPool2d with count_include_pad=True (default).
For this task kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, so output height = (2560 - 2) / 2 + 1 = 1280, width = 1280.
Each output element is the mean of the corresponding 2x2 window, assuming no padding; when padding is nonzero, divisor is kernel_size*kernel_size (count_include_pad=True).
Input and output are contiguous float32 CUDA tensors.
Sum over channel dimension C with keepdim=True, producing shape [16,1,2560,2560].
Per-element float32 addition across 3 channels, no scaling.
Average pooling with kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0 on tensor [16,1,2560,2560].
Output shape [16,1,1280,1280]; each value is mean of a 2x2 spatial block.
Returns the pooled tensor [16,1,1280,1280] on CUDA.
